title: Unified Operator Shell and Navigation
outcome: All current NoorPath operator routes use one consistent operator workspace chrome with the approved NoorPath wordmark, operator business context, signed-in member account menu, grouped route navigation, aligned content and responsive mobile behavior while existing domain workflows remain unchanged.
actor: Approved operator members managing packages, departures, bookings and fulfilment work.
modules: Web owns operator shell presentation, responsive navigation and route composition.
Operators remains authoritative for operator membership, business identity and permissions.
Existing domain modules remain authoritative for package, booking, visa, accommodation, manifest and handover behavior.
This slice does not change server authorization or tenant isolation.
routes: Operator overview -> Packages -> Departures -> Bookings through one shared workspace navigation
Operator workspace -> Operations -> Visa, Support, Cancellations
Operator workspace -> Account -> signed-in member account menu
Packages -> Create package -> shared operator shell -> existing package quick start / clone flow
Departures -> New or existing departure -> shared operator shell -> existing authoring flow
Departure -> Customer preview / Publication review -> shared operator shell
acceptance: Operator routes render one approved NoorPath wordmark/header treatment and one route-aware navigation system.
Operator business display name remains distinct from the signed-in member account menu.
Desktop navigation groups Workspace, Operations and Account destinations using real routes.
Mobile navigation exposes the same destinations through a keyboard-operable native disclosure.
Package quick start, departure authoring, customer preview and publication review no longer expose a competing operator sidebar or brand when rendered in operator routes.
Existing package, pricing, inventory, booking, payment, visa, accommodation, manifest and handover business behavior remains unchanged.
Operator access remains fail-closed and tenant isolation remains server-enforced.
Changed operator UI preserves NoorPath tokens, visible focus, 44px targets, responsive reflow and no horizontal overflow at 390px.
Rendered and navigation evidence belongs to the exact unchanged implementation SHA.
exclusions: Moving staff routes to a dedicated portal hostname.
New operator permissions or changes to tenant isolation.
Changing the NoorPath icon family or adding a new UI dependency.
